posts.t:
Bowen Byram isn't available for tomorrow's game. Andrew Mangiapane and Kevin Korchinski are expected to play. 

Jeff Blashill didn't say much on Moore's likely healthy scratch. Reading between the lines, Moore's offensive zone turnover leading to the Canadiens' first goal didn't help his standing.
Bowen Byram appears to be joining the Blackhawks for practice but is in a non-contact jersey.
Bowen Byram is trending towards returning, Jeff Blashill said.
